sections.title: Sharing Boards for 2
sections.description: Our charcuterie comes from Shropshire Salumi, a small family producer near Shrewsbury and we're proud to be the only place in London serving it. Started by charcuterie enthusiast Will Macken, using outdoor-reared Gloucester Old Spot pork sourced within two miles of their curing room, it's grown into a full scale curing operation, using British ingredients.
